title: Chocolate Lasagna
description: Chocolate graham crackers are layered with white chocolate pudding and topped with chocolate candy bar pieces creating a fun chocolate lasagna.
ingredients: 3 (3.4 ounce) packages fat-free instant white chocolate pudding mix
2 (8 ounce) tubs fat-free whipped topping (such as Cool Whip®), divided
1 (1.5 ounce) milk chocolate candy bar (such as Hershey's®), cut into pieces

steps.text: Whisk together skim milk and white chocolate pudding mixes in a large bowl until thickened and smooth. Fold in 1 tub whipped topping until incorporated.

Line a 9x13-inch casserole dish with a single layer of graham crackers. Spread 1/2 of the pudding mixture over graham cracker layer. Repeat layering with graham crackers and remaining pudding mixture, ending with a layer of graham crackers.
Spread remaining 1 tub whipped topping over the top graham cracker layer; sprinkle with candy bar pieces. Chill in the refrigerator until set, 2 to 4 hours.
